objective: Maximize event-F1 AUC at fixed exact-oracle budgets under the shared K3 materializer.

candidate.name: Proxy-Stratified Temporal Retrieval
candidate.inputs: the same public per-unit proxy score available to ARC and unit time order
selection_rule: For population n and budget B, set M=min(n,B+floor(B/4)).
Partition unit IDs into M equal contiguous cells using boundaries floor(n*c/M).
Choose the maximum-proxy unit in each nonempty cell, breaking ties by smaller unit ID.
Rank cell winners by decreasing proxy score, then smaller unit ID, and return the first B distinct units.
candidate.fitted_parameter_disclosure: The one-quarter cell overhead was chosen after labels from all four available realcartest domains had been opened.

development_evidence.leave_one_domain_out_result: three strict wins and one tie versus the five-seed shared-K3 ARC comparator; zero losses
development_evidence.warning: The four domains share one source video and were not prospectively unopened when PSTR was proposed.

future_confirmation_contract.required_data: at least one independently sourced video whose unit oracle labels and event reference are not opened until after PSTR selections are sealed
future_confirmation_contract.preferred_data: multiple videos with human-adjudicated event references
mandatory_additional_comparators: SUPG adapted to exact-B plus shared K3
a DPP or equivalent diversified-retrieval baseline
future_confirmation_contract.fairness: Each primary method selects exactly B unique units and uses identical cached-or-physical oracle observations, K3 materialization, and event evaluator.
future_confirmation_contract.primary_decision: PSTR normalized event-F1 AUC must strictly exceed both pure proxy top-k and shared-K3 ARC on the pooled external data.
future_confirmation_contract.budget_shape_decision: PSTR must be no worse than both comparators at a majority of evaluated budget points; report every point regardless of outcome.
future_confirmation_contract.efficiency_decision: Any advantage must remain visible in distinct event discoveries and may not be explained only by broader per-event intervals or a different materializer.
future_confirmation_contract.failure_action: Reject PSTR-5:4 without tuning the cell overhead on the confirmation data.

claim_limit: This freeze defines a candidate and a future falsification test. It is not evidence of prospective, human-ground-truth, native-ARC, or broad cross-video superiority.
